overall_goal: Log nutritional values, measure ingredients, and clean up the workspace

goals.description: Retrieve ingredients and log initial measurements
goals.rationale: The person opens the refrigerator to get ingredients, sets up the scale, and uses their phone to scan and record measurements for the salad and cucumber.

goals.description: Manage the workspace and prepare for chopping
goals.rationale: The person clears vegetables and peels out of the way, moves the chopping board, and positions ingredients like bread and onion to prepare for cutting.

goals.description: Add salad seeds and log their measurements
goals.rationale: The person scoops salad seeds into the bowl and uses their phone to record the added amount.

goals.description: Log measurements for coriander and prepare it
goals.rationale: The person scans the coriander with their phone to log its measurements, then places it on the cutting board.

goals.description: Log measurements for the Tupperware container
goals.rationale: The person handles a Tupperware container, adjusting the scale to record its measurements.

goals.description: Log nutritional values for olive oil and balsamic glaze
goals.rationale: The person scans the barcodes of the olive oil and balsamic glaze bottles with their phone to record their nutritional values in the app.

goals.description: Add seasonings and log their nutritional values
goals.rationale: The person adds salt, pepper, and oregano to the salad, using their phone to log the nutritional values of each seasoning.

goals.description: Clean up ingredients and the workspace
goals.rationale: The person puts away the oil, glaze, shakers, and vegetables into the refrigerator, then scrapes food scraps into the trash and moves the chopping board to the sink.

goals.description: Log nutritional values and measure the bread
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the cutting board to prepare more bread, scans the baguette's barcode to log its nutritional value, and weighs a slice on the scale.

goals.description: Perform final cleanup and prepare for serving
goals.rationale: The person clears utensils and the cutting board to the sink, puts the red onion away, throws away scraps, and sets out plates with the salad bowl.
